name: Lurker
soul: The soul of one who watches from the edge of the room, and would be mortified to be thanked.
spark: The mote is behind you. When you turn it is still behind you. Your classmates can see it; you have learned not to try.

hybrid.text: It stands behind things. It has never said why, and nothing has yet got past it.

settled.name: Small Shadow
settled.text: A shadow at your heel that is not yours and does not match the lamp. It has not done anything. It is very attentive.
settled.sign: A shadow at your heel that falls the wrong way for the lamp. It is a little darker where the eyes would be.
settled.habit: When you sit, it pools under the chair. When you look, it is behind the chair.

paths.name: Back-stander
paths.of: one who looks after people from where they cannot be thanked for it
paths.text: It learned from you that the place behind someone is a place that needs filling.
paths.sign: Broad across the back and always a half step behind somebody. It turns away when looked at.
paths.habit: It stands behind whoever in the room is most tired.

prongs.name: Long Shadow
prongs.of: one who keeps a whole room in the corner of their eye
prongs.text: It lies across the whole party at dusk. Things that step on it are noticed.
prongs.sign: It stretches long across the floor at dusk, and there are old, patient eyes in it somewhere.
prongs.habit: At sunset it lies across every doorway at once.

finishes.name: The Last in Line
finishes.of: one who walks last so that nobody else is last
finishes.text: Count the party and there is one more than there should be, at the back. Nothing has ever taken the one in front of it.
finishes.sign: Tall and thin at the very back of any file of people, where the lamp does not quite reach.
finishes.habit: It lets everyone through a door before it, including people it does not know.

finishes.name: Shadow of the Cohort
finishes.of: one who has stood behind each friend once, on the day it mattered
finishes.text: Each of your classmates has caught it standing behind them once. None of them was hurt that day.
finishes.sign: A single pale eye opens in it when one of the twelve is in the room.
finishes.habit: It moves from behind one classmate to the next through the evening, and stays longest with the quiet one.

prongs.name: Blow-eater
prongs.of: one who takes what was meant for another and says nothing
prongs.text: What is aimed at your back goes into it and does not come out the other side.
prongs.sign: There is a wide dark place in the middle of it, like a mouth, and no sound comes out.
prongs.habit: It leans over your shoulder when voices are raised, between you and the voice.

finishes.name: The Hollow Behind
finishes.of: one who has taken so much for another that it has their shape
finishes.text: It has swallowed so many blows meant for you that it has a shape now. The shape is yours, turned round.
finishes.sign: It has your outline, facing the other way, with a second faint face at the back of the head.
finishes.habit: It stands back to back with you, and matches how you stand.

finishes.name: Dark Parry
finishes.of: one who covers the side a friend forgot
finishes.text: Your guard goes up and its goes up behind you. A foe that circles finds the back is also a front.
finishes.sign: A blank pale mask hangs in the dark of it, and lifts when your guard lifts.
finishes.habit: It copies your guard while you practise, from behind you, facing the other way.

prongs.name: Door-shadow
prongs.of: one who closes a way by standing in it
prongs.text: Stand it in a doorway and the doorway is shut, though you can see straight through it.
prongs.sign: It stands in a doorway in the shape of a door. You can see through it, and nobody walks through.
prongs.habit: It stands in the dormitory door after lights-out until the last breath in the room slows.

finishes.name: Dark Threshold
finishes.of: one past whom the trouble does not come
finishes.text: It keeps the door of every post you hold. The line's dark stops at it and waits.
finishes.sign: The air in front of it stands thick and still, and lamp smoke bends away.
finishes.habit: It keeps to the sill of whatever room you are in, on the inside.

finishes.name: Cellar-keeper
finishes.of: one who went down to look so that no one else had to
finishes.text: It knows what is under every ruin, because it went down and stood behind that too.
finishes.sign: Its eyes are the black of a stair going down. There is brick dust on what would be its hands.
finishes.habit: It goes down first into any cellar, and stands at the bottom until you have come.

paths.name: The One Who Sits Up
paths.of: one who sits up with the sick and the dead and does not mention it
paths.text: It learned from you that somebody should be awake when the worst hour comes. It is there, in the chair, and has never said so.
paths.sign: It is the shape of someone sitting forward in a chair. When it speaks it is low, and only at night.
paths.habit: It keeps to the chair by your bed until the window goes grey.

prongs.name: Vigil Shadow
prongs.of: one the dead find easier to talk to than the living
prongs.text: It sits up with the dead of your hall at the lamp hour. They find it easier to talk to than you.
prongs.sign: It holds a covered lamp in its lap and sits with its head bent, as if at a bedside.
prongs.habit: At the lamp hour it sits at the hearth among the shades, and its lamp is the one they do not dim.

finishes.name: Night-long Vigil
finishes.of: one who has heard what the dying would not tell their own
finishes.text: It has kept watch for every shade you spoke with. They have told it what they would not tell the living.
finishes.sign: Its eyes are old and do not close. The lamp has burned down and it has not noticed.
finishes.habit: It sits through until dawn without shifting, and goes out as the birds start.

finishes.name: Sickroom Shadow
finishes.of: one who is in the chair when you wake
finishes.text: It is in the chair when you wake hurt at night. It has not slept either. It will not say so.
finishes.sign: A faint warm light under what would be its hands, held where you can see it from the pillow.
finishes.habit: When you wake hurt it looks away, as if it had only just sat down.

prongs.name: The One Behind
prongs.of: one who says the true thing quietly, at the ear
prongs.text: The foe hears its own name said softly at its shoulder, and turns. That is all you needed.
prongs.sign: A second, smaller face rides at its shoulder and does the talking, very low.
prongs.habit: It leans to the ear of whoever is speaking, and they lose the thread.

finishes.name: Oath-shadow
finishes.of: one who heard you promise and has not forgotten a word
finishes.text: It was behind you when you swore and heard every word. It says them back if you start to break one.
finishes.sign: It carries a thin dark book it never opens. Its lips shape your Terms when you hesitate.
finishes.habit: It stands at the foot of the bed on the night of any day you nearly broke your word.

finishes.name: The Voice at the Shoulder
finishes.of: one who moves others with a word and stays out of sight
finishes.text: It tells the foe where to stand. The foe goes there, and afterwards does not know why.
finishes.sign: A dim crown sits over the second face. The first has no mouth at all.
finishes.habit: It murmurs to other genii in passing, and they go and sit somewhere else.

prongs.name: Long-reaching Shadow
prongs.of: one whose watch does not stop at the door
prongs.text: Its watch does not stop at the door of the room. Your shot casts a shadow as it flies, and the shadow has hands.
prongs.sign: Its arms are longer than it is tall, and it stands at the far wall of any room.
prongs.habit: It reaches across the room for things without moving its feet.

finishes.name: Shot-shadow
finishes.of: one who goes along with what was sent, to see it arrive
finishes.text: It travels in the dark behind whatever you throw, arrives at the same moment, and stays.
finishes.sign: Hooked dark fingers, and a way of reaching the far end of things at the same time as the noise.
finishes.habit: It follows a thrown ball and is standing over it when it stops.

finishes.name: Name-stalker
finishes.of: one who will sit outside a door for as long as it takes
finishes.text: It has stood behind every named beast you hunt, in its den, for nights, learning how it sleeps.
finishes.sign: One side of it is all ear, turned to a wall. It has been there since you came in.
finishes.habit: It sits outside one door all night, listening to something breathe.

paths.name: The Unremarked
paths.of: one who would rather not be looked at
paths.text: It learned from you to stand where eyes slide off. People count the room and get the right number with the two of you left out.
paths.sign: It stands with its collar up in the one part of the room the lamp misses. Eyes slide off it.
paths.habit: It leaves a room when it is mentioned.

prongs.name: Garrotter
prongs.of: one who does the hard thing from behind, where nobody need see
prongs.text: It arrives with your blade, from the other side. The foe has to choose, and both answers are wrong.
prongs.sign: A thin chain hangs between its two hands, and it holds them a little apart.
prongs.habit: It winds the chain round its wrists and unwinds it, all evening.

finishes.name: Second Assailant
finishes.of: one who lends a hand nobody will ever credit
finishes.text: Your Pattern's chain has a hand in it that is not yours. The blows land in pairs.
finishes.sign: It has a short dark blade the same shape as yours, held in the other hand.
finishes.habit: It goes through your drills beside you, a beat after, on the wall.

finishes.name: The Thing in the Corner
finishes.of: one who is most present when there is nobody else
finishes.text: When you work alone, the foe keeps glancing past you. It is right to.
finishes.sign: One pale eye, open, in the corner of the ceiling. It was not there when you had company.
finishes.habit: It takes the corner behind the door, and comes out when the last visitor has gone.

prongs.name: Reader-over-the-shoulder
prongs.of: one who reads everything and is never seen reading
prongs.text: It reads the foe the way it reads your letters: from behind, and all of it.
prongs.sign: Its eyes are set forward and wide, and you feel them on the page before you see them.
prongs.habit: It reads your letters from behind you, and has finished before you have.

finishes.name: Cold Premonition
finishes.of: one whose only warning is a change in the air
finishes.text: A cold place at your back a breath before the strike. Guard when you feel it.
finishes.sign: A patch of cold at your back the size of a hand. Your breath shows when it is near.
finishes.habit: It stands close behind you in doorways for a moment before you go through.

finishes.name: The Quiet at Your Back
finishes.of: one who has made sure, without saying, that nothing follows
finishes.text: In the Quiet it is the only thing behind you, and it has made sure of that.
finishes.sign: No sound comes from behind you at all: no step, no cloth, no breath. That is it.
finishes.habit: It walks behind you on the way home, and the road behind is very quiet.

prongs.name: Pack-thinner
prongs.of: one who deals with a thing from the back, one piece at a time
prongs.text: It takes the one at the back of the pack. Then there is a new one at the back.
prongs.sign: Long thin legs that fold the wrong way. It is always at the rear of whatever it follows.
prongs.habit: It takes one biscuit from the back of the tin. Then there is a new one at the back.

finishes.name: The Count One Short
finishes.of: one who is noticed only by what is missing afterward
finishes.text: The green's packs have learned to count themselves. The count is always one short.
finishes.sign: Eyes like two holes in the hedge. You count the trees and there is one too many.
finishes.habit: It stands among the coats on a rack and is not found until one is taken.

finishes.name: The Dark Ahead
finishes.of: one who goes first only where it is worst
finishes.text: In the deep places it goes ahead, which it does nowhere else. Follow the dark that moves.
finishes.sign: A cold dark shape a few paces in front of the lamp, where it has never stood before.
finishes.habit: On an ordinary road it hangs back. On a bad one it is suddenly in front.
